responsibility: Implements the small red-black tree library used by rs6000-gen-builtins.cc during build-time code generation. It provides string-keyed tree initialization, insertion with balancing rotations, lookup, inorder dumping, and inorder callback traversal, supplying the generator with an ordered set/map structure for tracking builtin IDs, overload IDs, and generated function-type declarations while parsing the .def files.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the rbtree pair: it defines the tree algorithms—initialization, rotations, insertion, lookup, dump, and traversal—whereas rbtree.h only declares the data structures and function prototypes for the build-time utility.
